description:
Record money received against threads, and produce billed-versus-received statements. Each thread's payments are stored in threads/<Kind>/<Name>/payments.md.

Subcommands:
  log THREAD AMOUNT [-c CODE] [-d DATE] [-t HH:MM] [-a ACCOUNT] [-n NOTE] — record a receipt
  list [THREAD] [--since D] [--until D] [--json] — list payments
  statement [--thread T] [--since D] [--until D] [--as-of D] [--pdf PATH] [--opening D] [--json] — billed vs received, by thread and currency
  show ID [--json] — show one payment
  edit ID [--amount N] [-c CODE] [-d DATE] [-t HH:MM] [-a ACCOUNT] [-n NOTE] — change fields of a payment
  rm ID -y — permanently delete a payment

Args:
  THREAD  'Kind/Name', name or wikilink
  AMOUNT  amount received; required; must be positive
  ID      8-char payment id from `payments list`

Flags:
  log:
    -c, --currency CODE    ISO code; defaults to the thread's
    -d, --date YYYY-MM-DD  date received; default today
    -t, --time HH:MM       default now
    -a, --account TEXT     account the money landed in
    -n, --note TEXT        free-text note
  list:
    --since YYYY-MM-DD, --until YYYY-MM-DD, --json
  statement:
    --thread T             only this thread
    --since / --until YYYY-MM-DD
    --as-of YYYY-MM-DD     statement date; drives aging; default today
    --pdf PATH             render a PDF to PATH; requires --thread
    --opening YYYY-MM-DD   first day the PDF ledger shows; earlier items become one balance-brought-forward line; needs --pdf; not with --since/--until; not after --as-of
    --json                 JSON output
  show:
    --json
  edit:
    --amount N, -c/--currency CODE, -d/--date YYYY-MM-DD, -t/--time HH:MM, -a/--account TEXT, -n/--note TEXT
  rm:
    -y, --yes              required to confirm

Examples:
  ["log", "Projects/Northwind", "12500.00", "-c", "ZAR", "-d", "2026-09-30", "-n", "Invoice 42"]
  ["statement", "--thread", "Projects/Northwind", "--json"]
  ["statement", "--thread", "Projects/Northwind", "--pdf", "out/northwind-statement.pdf"]
  ["rm", "9f8e7d6c", "-y"]

Notes:
  -n consumes every word after it, so put it last.
  `log` adds a REF: line to buffer.md, filed under the date received. It reaches the thread's log on the next `buffer flush`.
  Statement PDFs need pandoc, xelatex and a client_name in the thread's frontmatter.
  Do not hand-edit payments.md. `rm` is permanent.
  Exit 1 means one of: a missing or non-positive amount, --pdf without --thread, --opening without --pdf, --opening with --since/--until, or --opening after --as-of.
